description: Removes this credential from the owners of a site. Two-step: the first call returns a confirmation token, the second performs the removal.

confirm_token.description: The token from this tool's previous refusal. Call without it first to see what would happen and receive the token; it cannot be guessed or reused.

id.description: The verification resource id, as returned by list_verified_sites. It is not the property URL — it is an opaque string such as "dns://example.com" or "https://example.com/".

name: unverify_site
title: Remove ownership
